method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: compilation of the Act from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 48361, retrieved 7 September 2026); no compilation number stated; latest amendments shown are the Firearms Act 2024 (No. 23 of 2024) ss 485-487 and the Criminal Law (Mental Impairment) Act 2023 (No. 10 of 2023); with the Security and Related Activities (Control) Regulations 1997 as deposited at ../../../security-and-related-activities-control-regulations-1997 (mrdoc 49704, version 07-ae0-00, currency from 1 July 2026, retrieved 20 October 2026), Schedule 4 fees as inserted by SL 2026/115 ($434 a licence for up to 3 years, $135 for fingerprints)

checks.command: l4 run sarca-cases-licensing.l4; l4 run sarca-qa-cases.l4; l4 check sarca-qa.l4
checks.result: 319 assertions satisfied (69 + 250), 0 errors, 0 warnings, in every file; l4 check sarca-qa.l4 succeeds
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 3, 4, 4A, 4B (prohibited person, finding of guilt, spent convictions), 5, 11, 12, 13(a), 14, 14A, 28, 35 (who needs which licence), 15, 16, 19, 20, 43 (working unlicensed; employment by a security agent), 23-26 (firearms and batons), 42A, 46, 47(1)(f), 49(3), 52, 52A, 53, 55, 57, 60 (issue, term, renewal), 61, 77(2), 77A, 67A, 69(1a), 79B, 80, 81, 72, 88A; regs 5A, 5B, 9, 16, 17(1)(f), 24, 25, 54; Sch 1 cl 7, 9, 11(2), 11B; Sch 2 (as an input); Sch 4; Sch 5 Div 1
seat: the security officer and licence applicant (Jake at 27, joining Sentinel)

roles: I work, or want to work, as a security officer
I run a business that supplies security officers to others
I hire or employ security for my own property

situation_parameters.name: I hold a security officer's licence
situation_parameters.description: Whether you hold a security officer's licence now
situation_parameters.role: I work, or want to work, as a security officer
questions: May I work as a licensed security officer on these terms
May I be employed as a security officer before my licence is issued
May I carry a baton at work
May I carry a firearm at work for this task
Is my application to renew my licence on time
May my licence be renewed
May I start my shift on these facts
Must I show my identity card to this person
Must I tell the licensing officer about this, and by when
Did I tell the licensing officer about this in time
What happens to my licence after the Commissioner's conclusion
Can the Commissioner direct me to give a blood or urine sample
does_not_arise: TRUE (for "May I be employed as a security officer before my licence is issued")

situation_parameters.name: I have a past charge or other matter for an offence
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have ever been charged with an offence, anywhere, or been cautioned or referred for one (the questions about a past matter arise only then)
situation_parameters.role: I work, or want to work, as a security officer
questions: Is this matter a finding of guilt
For how many years does this matter disqualify me
Does this matter make me a prohibited person on this day

situation_parameters.name: the licensing officer refused to issue me a licence
situation_parameters.description: Whether a licensing officer has refused your application for a licence (s 57(1))
situation_parameters.role: I work, or want to work, as a security officer
questions: Was I given written reasons for refusing my licence in time

situation_parameters.name: the licensing officer refused to renew my licence
situation_parameters.description: Whether a licensing officer has refused to renew your licence (s 57(2))
situation_parameters.role: I work, or want to work, as a security officer
questions: Was I told in time that my licence would not be renewed

situation_parameters.name: I am said to have committed an offence under this Act
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have been charged with, or given an infringement notice for, an offence under the Security and Related Activities (Control) Act 1996 (the penalty questions arise only then)
role: I work, or want to work, as a security officer
I run a business that supplies security officers to others
questions: What is the most a court can fine me for this offence
Can I be given an infringement notice for this offence
What is the modified penalty for this offence
What is the most a court can fine me for this offence of my business
What is the modified penalty for this offence of my business

situation_parameters.name: how I get security for my property
situation_parameters.type: How I get security for my property
situation_parameters.description: Whether you employ your own guard, hire a security firm to supply guards, or both
situation_parameters.role: I hire or employ security for my own property
questions: Does a guard I employ myself need a security officer's licence
May I employ this guard
What is the most I can be fined for employing an unlicensed guard
What is the modified penalty for employing an unlicensed guard
Must the security firm I hire hold a security agent's licence
does_not_arise: I hire a security firm to supply guards (for the four own-guard questions)
I employ my own guard (for the hired-firm question)

qa_layer.notes: NOTES.md, "Q&A layer (seat and situations as parameters)"
